mostWorthwhile.text: Following the pancreas's signal to the liver was most worthwhile: it connected falling blood glucose to releasing stored fuel and showed the signal weakening afterward.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to move directly from the after-meal body to the between-meals situation was confusing because that body had no available combination.

surprise.text: I expected the two situations to follow directly, but the hint showed that the between-meals sequence starts from a separate view of the original body.

arbitrary.text: Having to combine glucose-rich blood with the body before the pancreas could sense it felt like an extra prerequisite; the picture made the pancreas pairing seem plausible immediately.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: comparing the two responses and seeing their signals fade made me curious about other ways the body adjusts.
